violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sauerkraut (48F), sliced ham (49F), corned beef (47F) in 2 door prep on cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Person in charge discarded listed items.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: service cups stored in ice bin at bar for dispensing ice.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Person in charge removed cups from ice bin.

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer sour cream containers were observed reused for the storage of cooked corn in steam well.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. Person in charge discarded containers.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers stored on cook line in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. PIC placed all open drink containers in designated storage. MCLEAN FAMILY RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 11/07/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: raw shell eggs stored on cook line at 65F ambient temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. PIC will use eggs for the remainder of four hours and discard all remaining raw shell eggs.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticides
violations.observation: Restricted use pesticides do not meet the requirements in 40 CFR 152 Subpart 1 Classification of Pesticides. Observed “HOT SHOT” fly spray stored in cove of stairwell wall.
violations.corrective_action: Restricted use pesticides that do not meet the requirements of 40 CFR 152 may be toxic, which may result in the contamination of food. These pesticides shall not be used. PIC discarded pesticide.

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer sour cream and peeled garlic containers were observed reused for the storage of minced garlic and oil and other prepared foods.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC discarded single use containers.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in two different sanitizer wiping cloth buckets with a concentration of 0 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. PIC remade the solutions and they were tested at 100ppm chlorine. MCLEAN FAMILY RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 05/29/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Reduced Oxygen Packaged (ROP) tuna steaks are not being removed from the vacuum packaging prior to completing thawing as stated by Manufacturer’s instructions.
violations.corrective_action: PIC removed the fish from the low/no oxygen environment by cutting all bags open. Staff must be informed of proper thawing procedures and pay attention to manufacturer’s handling instructions on all food packaging.
